messages:
jordan: heads-up — we saw a ~30% jump in tenant-preview credit consumption for a subset of requests since the route-pricing change rolled at 06:00 UTC. Anyone else seeing this?

mia: looking... grabbing query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events WHERE route='preview' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T06:00Z'` :eyes:

billing-bot: Alert: spike detected on route=preview tenant_group=alpha threshold=20% increase. Please investigate.

sam: @mia can you dump route tag headers on the affected requests? My hunch: header normalization lost the promo tag on the retry path. Also check the route_hint mapping job.

mia: quick dump command I ran: `kcat -C -b kafka:9092 -t ingress-raw -o beginning -e | jq 'select(.route=="preview").headers' | head` — I see `X-Route: preview; X-Route-Hint: promo=alpha` for most, but ~7% of samples are missing `X-Route-Hint`.

lee: console shows preview-route consumption up but invoice-preview not reflecting promo discount. The upstream aggregation pipeline joins on `route_hint`; if it's missing we default to full price.

sam: could be sidecar change. Which canary rolled around 05:58? @ops?

ops: canary-roll bot: rolled sidecar v2.14.1 to edge pool canary-22 at 05:59 UTC. No immediate deploy CI failures reported.

mia: correlating client ids — pattern: affected requests originate via proxy-proto-1 from eu-west-2 and have `retry_count > 0`.

jordan: rollback option: revert sidecar canary or patch to ensure X-Route-Hint is copied on retry logic. Which is faster?

sam: faster short-term: emergency enrichment in ingest to reconstruct `route_hint` for preview route when retry_count>0 using customer_id->promo mapping. Longer-term: fix sidecar.

lee: UX point — console should show a "pricing derivation confidence" flag on invoice previews. Right now it silently shows charged amount which causes surprise when we later backfill promos.

mia: I'll open a small PR: idempotent enrichment step that fills `route_hint` when missing for preview route and retry_count>0. I'll add a perf note.

ops: created incident ticket INC-4921 to track rollback/patch decision and pager rotation if needed.

billing-bot: Finance flagged: if we retrocompute promos we'll need ledger corrections and possible customer outreach. Please include cost estimate in remediation.

jordan: good plan. @mia include sample query, perf delta (approx QPS * enrichment cost), and a dashboard card showing "hedging delta" before merging.

mia: will do. ETA for PR in ~2h.

sam: thanks. also can we add a quick smoke to routing e2e that asserts X-Route-Hint survives a retry?

lee: noted for Console Q2 improvements: surface derivation confidence + link to raw headers for audit.

jordan: thanks all — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
